text:
**$890 — quoted by Nkechi Adeyemi (MC 109876) on load #29000138, Camden, NJ → Yonkers, NY.**

- The counter came in 2026-05-11: "That rate doesn't work for us. We could do $890 – any room on your end?" [CE0099]
- The load posted at $780 for a 206-mile Box Truck run, picked up 2026-05-15, now delivered [load 29000138] — so the ask was $110 over the posted rate.
- Runner-up on the same load: $860 from Amara Diallo (MC 789012) [CE0107]. Next highest overall: $865 on load #29000614 Harrisburg→Dover [CE0162], and $775 on #29000660 Elizabeth→York [CE0176].
- Highest box-truck quote from a phone call is much lower: $530 from Eagle Express LLC (MC 945231) on a PA–MD run [call_004].

Scope: I reviewed all 36 box-truck rate-counter records (23 emails + 13 calls), pulled in four passes to get past the 20-row page cap. Calls are undated in this dataset, so no date filter was applied. Note the dataset flags `rate_found_but_stated_null` on these counters — the quoted dollar figure comes from the extraction over the raw text, which matches the snippet in each case.

Quotes buried in other intent types (e.g. an availability offer that names a price) aren't captured by this filter.
